title: Dark Text Note Card
description: Single-card text post: a charcoal canvas with one left-aligned statement set in display-scale grotesque type, an accent rule above it and a handle line at the foot. No imagery, no decoration beyond the accent bar, so the sentence carries the whole frame.
why_it_works: A text-only card reads as a personal note rather than an ad, which slows the scroll in an image-heavy feed. Left alignment with a short measure keeps the sentence scannable in one pass, and the empty lower half gives the eye a resting zone that makes the statement feel deliberate.
content_brief: Write one complete thought, not a headline: a stance, an observation or a confession the audience will recognise. Keep note_statement under 120 characters and break it into short clauses so the type wraps into three to six lines. note_closer is a one-line sign-off or punchline in the accent colour, under 34 characters. Use the kicker for a topic or series label in uppercase. Do not add hashtags, emoji or hype adjectives; plain first-person voice performs best here.

slides.layout_note: Single card: accent rule and uppercase kicker at the top-left, display-scale statement below it, accent-coloured closing line, handle pinned to the foot next to a hairline divider.

slots.name: note_kicker
slots.hint: Series or topic label, uppercase, two or three words.

slots.name: note_statement
slots.hint: One complete thought in plain language; short clauses so it wraps into three to six lines.
slots.example: Most brand rewrites fail because nobody agreed on who the customer was in the first place.

slots.name: note_closer
slots.hint: One-line sign-off or punchline in the accent colour.
